title: Grateful Dead Live at Augusta Civic Center on 1984-10-11
lineage: Sony TC-D5M (original record deck - Dolby on) > Pre Sonus Inspire GT > Sound Forge > .wav files > Trader's Little Helper > flac and ffp files
source: source: 2 Beyer M160 & 1 Sennheiser 421 microphones > Nak MX100 w/2001 > Sony TC-D5M (Dolby on) - analog master cassettes;

ai_review.summary: Good‑sounding source with fuller mids and a solid mid‑80s performance, only marred by a brief flub on "Playing in the Band".
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the Beyer/Sen 421 combo capture for its fullness and reduced boom, noting it sounds better than most other sources. The show is described as a solid warm‑up during a strong two‑night run, with only a minor slip at the start of "Playing in the Band". Recording quality is generally good, though the reviewer had to splice in a drum track to fill missing bits.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed review rates the show 4 stars, highlighting strong sound and performance with only minor issues; confidence is medium due to limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fuller mids, less boomy than other sources; some missing sections required splicing in a drum track; overall clear and balanced despite minor gaps.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a solid warm‑up show during a two‑night run, maintaining consistent energy throughout.
